annotations.title: Mark a listing or a post for the user

description: Give one of the user's marks. A thumb on a listing: up, down, or none to take it back; a skill is rated only after the user took it, so take it with take first. A helpful mark on a post, a comment on a listing or a post in a thread, which the user's own post never takes. Or, on a question the user asked, the mark on the reply that solved it. A post is named by its number, which its line states on the page's markdown: read the page with read first. It needs the user's key. One mark a call: pass thumb, or helpful with post, or solved with post. Mark only what the user told you to.

address.description: The listing's or the thread's address, full or as its path.

helpful.description: With post: true marks the post helpful for the user, false takes the mark back.

post.description: The post's number on the page at address, for a helpful or a solved mark.

solved.description: On the user's own question, with post: true marks that reply as the answer. False takes the mark back and needs no post.

thumb.description: A listing's thumb: up, down, or none to take it back.
